name: Ca mu do
summary: A red grouper from the island’s coral, also called song fish. The flesh is lean, white, chewy, and sweet.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025, and Vietnam Tourism.
texture: Lean, white, and chewy, in Vietnam Tourism’s account. The fish grows to 30 kilograms and is most often sold at about 5.
howToEat: Grilled or steamed, or made into a sauce or salad, cooked over a medium fire with little spice, ginger, and spring onion.
where: Seaside restaurants in town, per Báo Điện Biên Phủ, 31 July 2026.
seoTitle: Ca mu do — red grouper in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cá mú đỏ is the red coral grouper of Côn Đảo, lean, white, chewy, and sweet, grilled or steamed with ginger and spring onion.
